<?php
/**
 * Distributed Cache Client with TLS-encrypted storage
 * Connects to cache nodes via mTLS and encrypts values at rest
 */

namespace App\Cache;

use App\Crypto\CertificateValidator;
use App\Network\TlsConnection;

class DistributedCacheClient
{
    private array $nodes;
    private array $connections = [];
    private CertificateValidator $certValidator;
    private string $encryptionKey;
    private int $replicationFactor;
    private array $trustedCAs;

    public function __construct(array $config)
    {
        $this->nodes = $config['nodes'] ?? [];
        $this->encryptionKey = $config['encryption_key'];
        $this->replicationFactor = $config['replication_factor'] ?? 2;
        $this->trustedCAs = $config['trusted_cas'] ?? [];
        $this->certValidator = new CertificateValidator($this->trustedCAs);
    }

    public function get(string $key): ?string
    {
        $node = $this->selectNode($key);
        $conn = $this->getConnection($node);
        
        $encrypted = $conn->sendCommand('GET', $key);
        if ($encrypted === null) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $this->decrypt($encrypted);
    }

    public function set(string $key, string $value, int $ttl = 3600): bool
    {
        $encrypted = $this->encrypt($value);
        $nodes = $this->selectReplicaNodes($key);
        $success = 0;
        
        foreach ($nodes as $node) {
            $conn = $this->getConnection($node);
            if ($conn->sendCommand('SET', $key, $encrypted, $ttl)) {
                $success++;
            }
        }
        
        return $success >= ceil($this->replicationFactor / 2);
    }

    private function getConnection(array $node): TlsConnection
    {
        $nodeId = $node['host'] . ':' . $node['port'];
        
        if (!isset($this->connections[$nodeId]) || !$this->connections[$nodeId]->isAlive()) {
            $this->connections[$nodeId] = $this->establishConnection($node);
        }
        
        return $this->connections[$nodeId];
    }

    private function establishConnection(array $node): TlsConnection
    {
        $context = $this->createTlsContext($node);
        $conn = new TlsConnection($node['host'], $node['port'], $context);
        
        $peerCert = $conn->getPeerCertificate();
        
        if (!$this->validateNodeCertificate($peerCert, $node)) {
            $conn->close();
            throw new \RuntimeException("Certificate validation failed for node {$node['host']}");
        }
        
        return $conn;
    }

    private function createTlsContext(array $node): array
    {
        $opts = [
            'ssl' => [
                'verify_peer' => true,
                'verify_peer_name' => true,
                'allow_self_signed' => false,
                'cafile' => $node['ca_file'] ?? '/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt',
                'local_cert' => $node['client_cert'] ?? null,
                'local_pk' => $node['client_key'] ?? null,
                'crypto_method' => STREAM_CRYPTO_METHOD_TLSv1_2_CLIENT | STREAM_CRYPTO_METHOD_TLSv1_3_CLIENT,
                'peer_name' => $node['expected_cn'] ?? $node['host'],
            ]
        ];
        
        return $opts;
    }

    private function validateNodeCertificate(array $peerCert, array $node): bool
    {
        // Validate certificate chain
        $chainValid = $this->certValidator->validateChain($peerCert);
        if (!$chainValid) {
            return false;
        }

        // Validate certificate hasn't expired
        $now = time();
        if ($now < $peerCert['validFrom_time_t'] || $now > $peerCert['validTo_time_t']) {
            return false;
        }

        // Validate the certificate's CN or SAN matches expected identity
        $expectedIdentity = $node['expected_cn'] ?? $node['host'];
        $certIdentities = $this->extractCertIdentities($peerCert);
        
        return $this->matchesIdentity($expectedIdentity, $certIdentities);
    }

    private function extractCertIdentities(array $cert): array
    {
        $identities = [];
        
        // Extract CN from subject
        if (isset($cert['subject']['CN'])) {
            $identities[] = $cert['subject']['CN'];
        }
        
        // Extract SANs
        if (isset($cert['extensions']['subjectAltName'])) {
            $sans = explode(',', $cert['extensions']['subjectAltName']);
            foreach ($sans as $san) {
                $san = trim($san);
                if (strpos($san, 'DNS:') === 0) {
                    $identities[] = substr($san, 4);
                }
            }
        }
        
        return $identities;
    }

    private function matchesIdentity(string $expected, array $certIdentities): bool
    {
        foreach ($certIdentities as $identity) {
            if ($this->wildcardMatch($identity, $expected)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Matches a certificate identity pattern against an expected hostname.
     * Supports wildcard certificates (e.g., *.example.com)
     * RFC 6125 Section 6.4.3: wildcard only in leftmost label
     */
    private function wildcardMatch(string $pattern, string $hostname): bool
    {
        $pattern = strtolower($pattern);
        $hostname = strtolower($hostname);
        
        if ($pattern === $hostname) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Check for wildcard
        if (strpos($pattern, '*') === false) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Wildcard must be in leftmost label only
        $patternParts = explode('.', $pattern);
        $hostParts = explode('.', $hostname);
        
        if (count($patternParts) < 2 || count($hostParts) < 2) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Must have same number of labels
        if (count($patternParts) !== count($hostParts)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Only first label can contain wildcard
        for ($i = 1; $i < count($patternParts); $i++) {
            if (strpos($patternParts[$i], '*') !== false) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        
        // Match non-wildcard labels
        for ($i = 1; $i < count($patternParts); $i++) {
            if ($patternParts[$i] !== $hostParts[$i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        
        // Match wildcard label - fnmatch style
        $wildcardLabel = $patternParts[0];
        $hostLabel = $hostParts[0];
        
        return fnmatch($wildcardLabel, $hostLabel);
    }

    private function selectNode(string $key): array
    {
        $hash = crc32($key);
        $index = abs($hash) % count($this->nodes);
        return $this->nodes[$index];
    }

    private function selectReplicaNodes(string $key): array
    {
        $hash = crc32($key);
        $startIndex = abs($hash) % count($this->nodes);
        $replicas = [];
        
        for ($i = 0; $i < min($this->replicationFactor, count($this->nodes)); $i++) {
            $replicas[] = $this->nodes[($startIndex + $i) % count($this->nodes)];
        }
        
        return $replicas;
    }

    private function encrypt(string $data): string
    {
        $iv = random_bytes(16);
        $encrypted = openssl_encrypt($data, 'aes-256-gcm', $this->encryptionKey, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag);
        return base64_encode($iv . $tag . $encrypted);
    }

    private function decrypt(string $data): string
    {
        $raw = base64_decode($data);
        $iv = substr($raw, 0, 16);
        $tag = substr($raw, 16, 16);
        $encrypted = substr($raw, 32);
        
        $decrypted = openssl_decrypt($encrypted, 'aes-256-gcm', $this->encryptionKey, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag);
        if ($decrypted === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Decryption failed - data integrity compromised');
        }
        return $decrypted;
    }
}

class CertificateValidator
{
    private array $trustedCAs;

    public function __construct(array $trustedCAs)
    {
        $this->trustedCAs = $trustedCAs;
    }

    public function validateChain(array $cert): bool
    {
        $issuer = $cert['issuer'] ?? [];
        $issuerDN = $this->buildDN($issuer);
        
        foreach ($this->trustedCAs as $ca) {
            if ($this->buildDN($ca['subject']) === $issuerDN) {
                return $this->verifySignature($cert, $ca);
            }
        }
        
        return false;
    }

    private function buildDN(array $components): string
    {
        ksort($components);
        $parts = [];
        foreach ($components as $key => $value) {
            $parts[] = "$key=$value";
        }
        return implode(',', $parts);
    }

    private function verifySignature(array $cert, array $ca): bool
    {
        if (!isset($ca['public_key']) || !isset($cert['signature'])) {
            return false;
        }
        return openssl_verify(
            $cert['tbsCertificate'] ?? '',
            base64_decode($cert['signature'] ?? ''),
            $ca['public_key'],
            OPENSSL_ALGO_SHA256
        ) === 1;
    }
}
